description: This file defines the BuzzPost class which represents a post in the OrangeHRM Buzz module, including properties such as id, employee, text content, timestamps, and associated photos and links. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes traits for decorators and date-time helpers.

classes.name: BuzzPost
classes.description: Entity class representing a buzz post, including properties for content, timestamps, related employee, photos, and links, with ORM mappings and utility traits.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the post.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the post.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who made the post.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Assigns an Employee as the author of the post.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the textual content of the post.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the textual content of the post.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp to the current time in UTC.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp in UTC.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Updates the last modified time to the current time in UTC.
